## Independent reviewer reproduction

```powershell
git rev-parse HEAD
git status --short
corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
corepack pnpm run test:scenario-approval
corepack pnpm run ci
py -3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests/governance -p "test_*.py" -v
corepack pnpm exec tsx -e "import { productionScenarioConfiguration } from './packages/content/src/index.ts'; import { hashCanonicalJson } from './packages/simulation/src/index.ts'; console.log(hashCanonicalJson(productionScenarioConfiguration));"
git diff --check
git diff --stat
```

Pass means the focused suite reports 8/8; CI and governance pass; the artifact hash is `ab4ccb03b7b638c62f37c27111a2bd27cd156008d2b8b4e8bcad7c5ecb42d904`; every role/procedure remains visibly simulated; no TEST_ONLY marker or source claim appears; AES/ECOWAS cannot grant; evaluation has six separate dimensions and no overall score; and the leaderboard remains disabled.

## Diff summary

Prompt 26 replaces the external-review blocker with the owner's narrower fictional/noncompetitive scope. It adds one schema-validated simulated policy, deterministic procedure and evaluation resolvers, edge-case tests and durable approval records. It does not integrate the production baseline/browser, claim real institutional law, represent real private intent, or add competitive scoring.
